purpose: Teach: 法廷/沈黙/欠陥/反射/偏見/中断/農薬/還元

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後の、本気で、絶対、法廷、絶対、ドラマ、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your postwar courtroom drama paper was really impressive. I have to say, the depth of your research genuinely moved me.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Slight pause before the compliment lands. Genuine interest in his work — not performative. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。文学の、本気で、絶対、沈黙、絶対、表現、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to explore how silence and expression function in the literature. Your support meant everything to me.
lines.style: Grateful and earnest, but quietly spoken. A little vulnerable underneath the politeness. Hesitates slightly before opening up about what the encouragement meant.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の、本気で、絶対、欠陥、絶対、住宅、絶対、問題、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: What struck me most was how broad your perspective was on postwar housing and urban problems. That took real intellectual courage.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. Leaning slightly forward with genuine interest. Voice lifts a little on 「視野が広い」 — real recognition of something difficult done well.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。物理学の、本気で、絶対、反射、絶対、現象、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to trace how physical reflection and phenomenon showed up across the historical timeline. Thank you for believing in that direction.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Speaking as if explaining something he cares about to someone who actually understands. Steady, no rush. Sincere without overstatement.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会的な、本気で、絶対、偏見、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you tackled social prejudice through history — it was genuinely thoughtful work. You should be proud of it.
lines.style: Direct, warm conviction. Not flattery. A teacher recognizing when a student has done something that matters. Slight nod of the head with the compliment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史的、本気で、絶対、中断、絶対、と、絶対、再建の、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to show how historical rupture and rebuilding shaped everything that came after. I'm grateful you saw what I was trying to do.
lines.style: Humble but not self-deprecating. Speaking carefully, like someone who wants to be understood. A little relief in the voice — his effort was seen.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の、本気で、絶対、農薬、絶対、規制史、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of postwar pesticide regulation and policy — that was remarkably insightful research. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warmth with authority. A teacher's recognition of a student reaching beyond what was asked. Slight emphatic weight on 「農薬」 and the scope of his thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。経済学の、本気で、絶対、還元、絶対、論、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I approached it through economic reduction theory to understand the incentive structures underneath. I appreciate you seeing that effort.
lines.style: Soft and genuine. The relief of being understood. Speaks a little more openly now — the conversation has built trust. Quiet but not withdrawn.
